Image Description: The image shows a plate of assorted food items. The plate has a blue and orange geometric pattern around the rim. On the plate, there are several distinct food portions:

1. A serving of fried potato wedges located at the top left of the plate.
2. A couple of slices of pickles and a portion of sliced white meat, possibly turkey or chicken, with mustard drizzled on top, at the top right.
3. A mound of cooked rice with bits of vegetables
